status: SOURCE-REVIEWED PROPOSAL ONLY - NOT CAD OR ORDER RELEASE
scope: Three labelled LEDs indicating measured selected COM voltage; no connection to motion command nets.

supply.source: COM_PLUS -> R26 82ohm -> BAT46W-7-F -> V_IND_IN -> AP7375-33SA-7 -> V_IND_3V3; input hold-up and collapse qualification pending.
supply.current_budget_status: 5 mA target includes the power agent's 4.7k rail bleeder (~0.70 mA). At most one LED on; MCU duty-cycled. Actual current and transient margin require measurement.

adc.reference_limit_note: The manufacturer gives characterization limits, not production-test guarantees. Include ADC gain/offset/leakage and temperature in calibration/qualification; do not claim +/-5% total system accuracy.

startup_injection.manufacturer_condition: VDD<=4.9V and VPIN<=5.5V, Table33-1 and current-limiting resistor note
startup_injection.rationale: The100k top resistor limits startup source current even before subtracting lower-resistor current; normal unloaded divider voltage is below1.0V. This accepts bounded injection, not zero injection.
limitations: Absolute injection limits do not establish ADC accuracy while clamping.
Review selected LDO output pre-bias/reverse-current tolerance, all power ramps and charged C51.
If COM is held externally while indicator supply is absent, measure rail current/voltage; never infer a functioning MCU from a partially back-powered rail.

configuration_requirements: Keep PA1 pull-up disabled and digital input buffer disabled.
Use valid ADC clock and acquisition duration; allow reference and RC settling before accepting results.
Declare saturated/invalid readings outside all voltage classes.

voltage_classes.status: PROPOSED NOMINAL UI WINDOWS - physical boundary accuracy not qualified
voltage_classes.outside_behavior: All LEDs off; 0V,8V,16V are explicit all-off test points.
voltage_classes.semantics: Nominal voltage class, not proof of driver compatibility or a protection function.
voltage_classes.guard_bands: Final guard bands require calibrated error budget and temperature validation. Never allow hysteresis to cross excluded gaps.

firmware_requirements.startup: All LEDs off until calibrated, stable readings after reset/reference/RC settling.
requirements: Clear PA6/PA7/PA2 output latches before enabling their output drivers.
Do not enable peripheral pin overrides on indicator GPIOs.
Enable suitable brownout reset and watchdog; qualify repeated slow ramps and power interruptions.
At most one LED may be on, including self-test; do not flash all three simultaneously.
Retain PA0 as UPDI. PA3 is unused and should be configured without a floating digital input after startup.
On missing/corrupt calibration, keep all LEDs off; verify calibration integrity and source version.
Keep motion interface independent of MCU execution and programming.

calibration.proposal: Measure at two traceable COM voltages spanning the range (for example5.000V and24.000V), store integer gain/offset with version/CRC, then sweep and record all six actual LED boundaries.
release_checks: Confirm 5/12/24 classification under loaded COM in both selector modes.
Check0,8,16V all-off; test overrange within safe input rating.
Validate temperature and supply variation, LED readability, ADC settling and startup/power-down behavior.

programming.tool_candidate: Adafruit UPDI Friend5879, reusable fixture,3.3V setting
programming.procedure_status: Fixture and exact fuse/HEX procedure not yet released
requirements: Program a disconnected adapter through its normal external-power path only after regulator and protection bench tests.
Use 3.3 V UPDI logic and common GND. Leave programmer VDD/power output disconnected; TP51 is measurement/sense only.
Do not parallel programmer power with the board supply or inject target power directly into V_IND_3V3.
Keep UPDI enabled; no bootloader required.
Programming pads require a matching pogo fixture or documented cable adapter.

notes: SOIC-8 pin mapping verified from manufacturer section4.1, printed page13. UPDI is physical pin6; PA3/EXTCLK is physical pin7.
LED GPIOs source current through individual resistors into LEDs to GND. They do not share UPDI or ADC.
DIR, OUT and PINnCTRL reset to zero: GPIO outputs disabled and pull-ups off. Firmware must clear LED output latches before setting DIR, then keep all LEDs off until valid settled/calibrated readings.
Use CPU clock <=5MHz. Nominal2.6V BODLEVEL2 spans2.4–2.9V and cannot establish the>=2.7V supply needed for10MHz.
Firmware, fuse image, calibration and physical operation have not been implemented or verified by this proposal.
